Results.ReviewText: So far so good. Grill heats evenly. After heating up the grill, regulator low setting and cover closed will give you a consistent cooking temperature between 350º and 375º. I like the porcelain enameled grates over stainless steel grates and they have been easy to clean with a brass grill brush and water.

Results.ReviewText: The second one I purchased.  They honored theirv5 year warranty on the first, so I gave it to my son-in-law and purchased another
Results.Title: Great Warranty

Results.ReviewText: This is a great little grill, especially if you are cooking simple meals.  My only issue is that there is only 1 burner control that goes around the whole bottom of the grilling area in a circle.  So if you want to cook something on indirect heat, it's pretty difficult to do so.  As the recipes in all the Weber cookbooks indicate, there are many items that should be grilled on indirect heat, and that is nearly impossible to accomplish with these small grills with only one burner.  If they made these grills with 2 separate burner controls, it would be perfect for a small grill.
Results.Title: Works great, but cannot use indirect heating

Results.ReviewText: I owned this grill before.  I forgot how much I missed it until I bought the new one.  Superb!  Even cooking and easy to manage.
Results.Title: I've Missed You

Results.ReviewText: It's great for a smaller grill. It is nice to know what the temperature is and be able to control it. Also very mobile if you want to take it to a picnic, tailgate, or camping.
Results.Title: Great small grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback! We are glad to hear that you like your new Weber Q. We understand the issues you are having and we are here to help! We designed the grates on your Weber Q to move drippings away from the burner underneath. Some drippings may reach the burner like any gas grill. Brushing the burner with a Weber grill brush will help keep it clean and working properly. To your next point, we find that the best way to retain heat in the grill is to keep the lid closed. Stones in a grill can collect drippings and create serious issues, which is why we do not recommend them. We hope that you will reach out to us if there is anything else that we can do to help. Thank you SO much for being a long-time Weber fan! Happy grilling!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: It's a well built and sturdy grill however there are no type of cover for the grease to drip directly on burner tube and many flare ups!! And you use a LOT of gas because there are no stones to retain heat in the grill!!! I've been a Weber customer for 40 years and feel they could have done better for the price!!

Results.ReviewText: Grill does very well for steaks, burgers, hot dogs. Way too hot with lid closed for anything needing to cook low and slow. The temp control regulator has a very limited turn down ratio, as it is hard to get anything below 400 deg F. So for chicken, been experimenting with keeping the lid partially open to let some of the heat out. Most everything else about this grill is spot on and really admire the easy to clean cooking grates which have a porcelain coating.
Results.Title: Not Perfect, but good portable small grill

Results.ReviewText: It is small. I’m used to the kettle grill and constantly prep too much food for this grill! Convenient size for 2 people.

Results.ReviewText: Simple setup, great room with the side extensions, and what's not to like with the even heating on the heavy duty grates. And it all folds together to make it compact enough to take along camping! Well thought out features make this my go to camping grill.

Even though it’s a small grill, it performs very well. 
Heats up quickly and cooks evenly. 
Puts a beautiful sear on steaks and chicken. 
I love this grill!
Results.Title: Weber Q1200

Results.ReviewText: After viewing a number of other grills, I purchased the Q1200 this past Spring and have been exceptionally pleased with the quality and performance of the grill.  Steaks and burgers are a staple, but I have also roasted a 4 pound hen and pork tenderloin with great results.  The grill packs easily in my small pickup for camping and I prepared 12 chicken thighs at once for a family of four.  Very easy to set up and clean.  Purchased the cart and grill cover as well.  I continue experiment with other recipes and to date, the outcomes have all been excellent!!  Great product - Well done Weber!!
Results.Title: Great for the deck or traveling!

Results.ReviewText: I enjoy using an American-made product! My Weber Q1200 grill is well-made and am confident that it will perform well and last a long time. I also purchased a companion grill cart that makes for easy moving.
